content_fidelity.instructions: Under this category and the contextual materiality policy, is the core information meaningfully preserved (acquired/patched) or adequate for the broad purpose (regenerated), without material loss? Exclude advertising and permissible temporal variation.

criteria.meets: Core interface meets this dimension under the category contract and contextual materiality policy.
criteria.material_defect: An observable material defect in core information or essential controls violates this dimension after applying contextual exclusions.
criteria.insufficient: Evidence is genuinely insufficient to assess essential interface requirements, not simply different or missing an optional region.

presentation.instructions: Is the observed core target content legible, coherently arranged and usable, allowing the contextual exclusions? Distinguish auxiliary media or temporary component states from repeated broken editorial/product imagery and substantial unreadability.

criteria.meets: Core interface meets this dimension under the category contract and contextual materiality policy.
criteria.material_defect: An observable material defect in core information or essential controls violates this dimension after applying contextual exclusions.
criteria.insufficient: Evidence is genuinely insufficient to assess essential interface requirements, not simply different or missing an optional region.

controls.instructions: Are essential visible controls identifiable and understandable, with required core controls preserved for acquired/patched pages? Optional advertising, promotional and third-party widgets need not match. A missing/unreadable essential label remains a defect; do not infer remote interaction success. Visible action controls for editorial content, products or primary tasks need readable visible text or a recognizable icon. A blurred or empty label on such a button is a material control defect even if other navigation is available. This does not apply to excluded advertisements or auxiliary external widgets. Distinguish the button itself from decorative animation around it.

criteria.meets: Core interface meets this dimension under the category contract and contextual materiality policy.
criteria.material_defect: An observable material defect in core information or essential controls violates this dimension after applying contextual exclusions.
criteria.insufficient: Evidence is genuinely insufficient to assess essential interface requirements, not simply different or missing an optional region.

evidence_coherence.instructions: Assess whether the supplied states belong to the intended reference/target comparison under its category and form a coherent assessable set. A permissible dynamic, advertising or regenerated-layout difference is not incoherence. controls.instructions: Are essential visible controls identifiable and understandable, with required core controls preserved for acquired/patched pages? controls.instructions: Are essential visible controls identifiable and understandable, with required core controls preserved for acquired/patched pages? A blurred or empty label on such a button is a material control defect even if other navigation is available. This does not apply to excluded advertisements or auxiliary external widgets. controls.instructions: Are essential visible controls identifiable and understandable, with required core controls preserved for acquired/patched pages? Visible action controls for editorial content, products or primary tasks need readable visible text or a recognizable icon. A blurred or empty label on such a button is a material control defect even if other navigation is available. This does not apply to excluded advertisements or auxiliary external widgets. Distinguish the button itself from decorative animation around it.

controls.instructions: Are essential visible controls identifiable and understandable, with required core controls preserved for acquired/patched pages? A blurred or empty label on such a button is a material control defect even if other navigation is available. This does not apply to excluded advertisements or auxiliary external widgets. controls.instructions: Are essential visible controls identifiable and understandable, with required core controls preserved for acquired/patched pages? Visible action controls for editorial content, products or primary tasks need readable visible text or a recognizable icon. A blurred or empty label on such a button is a material control defect even if other navigation is available. This does not apply to excluded advertisements or auxiliary external widgets. Distinguish the button itself from decorative animation around it.

Evaluate localized content/presentation/control defects in their own dimensions rather than treating every such difference as a mismatched evidence set.

criteria.material_defect: An observable material defect in core information or essential controls violates this dimension after applying contextual exclusions.
criteria.insufficient: Evidence is genuinely insufficient to assess essential interface requirements, not simply different or missing an optional region.

semantic_adequacy.instructions: Do the core target text, imagery and labels convey coherent meaning for the page purpose under the contextual materiality policy? Optional unavailable media and temporal differences alone do not destroy that meaning.
